content: {"episode_id":"ep-05146","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry, for episode ep-05146. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease. We request reconsideration of the $552.40 balance based on these documented indications."}
